name: history-missing-blob
goal: Report missing or invalid committed Git blobs without substituting empty source.

evidence: Git cat-file reports a missing object in a successful batch response, which the current parser accepts as an empty source file.
The existing populated read case checks missing paths but never removes a committed Git blob after listing its tree; strengthen that case and preserve its title.
Red 0299aac5807e at ae4f418b69 shows a missing committed blob is returned as empty text.
Commit a18ae0fa79 validates Git batch frames and rejects missing objects, malformed responses and subprocess failures.
Green ae7d1f3dbb29 passes the unchanged case, including valid peers and retries.
